scope: Repository-wide readability maintenance of owned Lean sources. Existing mathematical owners, modules, imports, namespaces, public names, binders, hypotheses, constants, dimensions and proof/certificate status are retained. No public API, module migration, new support lemma, axiom, wrapper or alias.

placement_plan.decision: Reflow existing statements and expressions, normalize spaces, and organize coherent long proofs in place. No file split or move.

reference: The local Formech prototype informed short lines and explicit local proof phases; KLS retains its established reusable-library design and naming policy.

exact_interface_comparison.method: Direct Lean Expr.equal on elaborated types including binder names/annotations and on all nonproof values; universes and safety/partiality checked separately. Theorem proof bodies are not required to be textually identical.

validation.source_preservation: Code characters and literal contents are unchanged modulo whitespace; existing mathematical comments are retained, with 100 additional phase explanations.
validation.full_local_verifier: Final outcome is governed by build/history/2026-10-29-style-cleanup/verification.json. Only status passed establishes completion.
validation.git: Existing staging preserved; no commit or push performed.
validation.legacy_style_checks: The three available pinned Mathlib Python checks report zero findings across all owned Lean files, including the bridge. The full Python CLI is not used because its pinned source refers to an undefined check.
validation.openai_bridge: Independent integrations/openai lake --wfail build passed (9389 jobs).

exceptions.third_party: All vendor sources, provenance locks and third-party licenses remain unchanged.
exceptions.metaprogramming: Keep the original layout of run_cmd/elab/macro/syntax commands; comment reflow is allowed. Their do/let-else and quotation layout is semantically significant.
